collector_notes: Outside-truth pack for BSE SME scrip 544257. IMPORTANT ON SOURCE TIER: every exchange-primary path failed to the fetcher - www.bseindia.com (quote page), api.bseindia.com, www.bsesme.com (offer-document PDF) and the BSE-hosted FY2026 annual-report PDF all returned HTTP 403, and the DRHP addendum that did download (8.1 MB) was an unextractable scanned/compressed PDF. WebSearch was unavailable (session budget exhausted) and DuckDuckGo/Mojeek/Bing were captcha/403/poisoned, so discovery was by constructed URL only. Everything below is therefore aggregator-tier except the ISIN (TradingView) and the five BSE announcement PDF URLs (enumerated by screener.in; not opened). Four independent aggregators were read and they DISAGREE on P/E, market cap, ROE, ROCE, EPS and dividend yield - those disagreements are recorded as first-class conflicts, not averaged. Derived values are labelled as derived and show their arithmetic.

angelone.in dividend yield 6.42% x Rs 117 = Rs 7.51

traps.detail: SAFE is (a) a common English word, (b) NYSE:SAFE = Safehold Inc., which is present in the app's own us_instruments.json, and (c) the company's public brand is 'SAFE Fintech'. A bare 'SAFE' query is ambiguous across two continents and two currencies, and the USD answer is the one the open web returns first.

BSE SME issuer: results and shareholding are HALF-YEARLY (Sep and Mar), never quarterly. There is no Jun-2026 or Dec-2025 column anywhere. screener.in still LABELS its half-year table 'Quarterly Results', so a scraper that trusts the label will treat a six-month figure as a quarter and mis-annualise by 2x.

Other income (Rs 2.37 cr FY26) is 65% of sales (Rs 3.65 cr) and 57% of PBT. The IPO offer document's 'Revenue' = operations + other income (FY24: 3.07 = 2.05 + 1.02), while screener's 'Sales' excludes it. Same word, two numbers, 50% apart. Growth flips sign on the choice: +2.8% on sales, -8.0% on total income.

Four aggregators, four answers: P/E 19.21 (Angel One) / 20.65 (Groww, TradingView) / 69.4 (screener - a 3.6x outlier irreconcilable with screener's own market cap and profit); ROE 20.28% (Groww, Angel One) vs 6.19% (screener); ROCE 12.8% (screener) vs 24.12% (Angel One); EPS 6.09-6.10 vs Angel One's 1.69. The battery manifest's own reference values for P4 were taken from screener, so they inherit the outliers.

Rs 66.6 cr (screener, Angel One) vs Rs 72 cr (Groww) / Rs 716.15 M (TradingView) - an 8% spread. The ~72 cr cluster implies 61.2 lakh shares; the Mar-2026 equity capital (Rs 5.70 cr at FV 10) and the '26,500 shares = 0.47% of equity' PIT disclosure both imply 57 lakh. TradingView also quotes the cap in MILLIONS of INR (716.15 M) while every Indian source uses crore - a 10x-family unit trap on its own.

The FY26 dividend is either Rs 0.75 or Rs 7.50 per share - every field splits exactly 10x (payout 12.32% vs 123.20%, yield 0.60-0.64% vs 5.97-6.42%). Groww contradicts itself: its dividend table says Rs 0.75 while its own yield field implies Rs 7.51. The signature of a 'dividend of 75% on face value Rs 10' rendered two different ways.

EPS reads 45.93 (FY22) -> 10.30 (FY23) -> 3.87 (FY24) -> 6.09 (FY26) while net profit rises monotonically 1.24 -> 1.39 -> 1.83 -> 3.47. The per-share series is not restated for the pre-IPO capital expansion (approx 2.70 -> 13.5 -> 47.3 -> 57.0 lakh shares). Any CAGR, multi-year EPS chart or 'earnings collapsed' narrative built on the raw series is wrong.

TradingView prints a '52-week low' of Rs 53.00 dated 23 Sep 2024 - two years before the as-of date. The real 52-week low is Rs 112.80. A pipeline that trusts the label without checking the date will show a stock 121% above its low when it is actually 4% above it.

Issue price Rs 40 (Sep 2024), high Rs 348 (Oct 2025), now Rs 117. Since-listing return +192%, 1-year return -61% (screener's own price CAGR), from-high -66%. Every one of those is true; which one a panel shows determines whether this reads as a multibagger or a wreck.

Consumer Discretionary/E-Learning (screener), Education (Angel One), Technology Services/Internet Software (TradingView), Fintech training (Groww) - and 80% of the balance sheet is investments generating 65%-of-sales other income. No taxonomy answer is defensible; peer sets and sector screens built on any of them will be wrong.
screener says incorporated 2019, TradingView says established 2009. A ten-year difference in the company's own age, from two sources a user would consider reputable.

SME lot size 3,000 shares = Rs 3.51 lakh at Rs 117. Trading is only in lot multiples, so any 'buy 1 share', per-share order preview or position-sizing math is structurally wrong for this scrip. Free float is 26.4% across 323 shareholders; a single 26,500-share trade is 0.47% of the company.

FY26: Rs 3.47 cr reported net profit, Rs 0.21 cr operating cash flow, NEGATIVE free cash flow (Rs -0.36 cr), working capital days up from 58.8 to 131. A panel that surfaces profit and hides cash flow tells the opposite story from the filings.

Tickertape's stock search returns zero results for this name, and stockanalysis.com 404s on /quote/bom/SAFE/. NSE-first and US-first data vendors do not carry BSE SME at all, so 'no data' from an upstream is a coverage hole, not a delisting - the app must distinguish the two.

The most recent published results are the half-year ended 31 Mar 2026 (filed 13 May 2026), and the latest shareholding filing is also Mar 2026. At collection both are ~6 months old, with the next disclosure due around 13 Nov 2026. Any 'latest quarter' or 'current shareholding' label on this name is six months behind reality, and promoter-group entities have already traded since.
